stories.title: Trump: "Let them take out Los Angeles. Let them take out San Diego"
stories.summary: At a campaign rally in Nebraska, talking about the war with Iran and high prices, Trump said: "It's a small price to pay. They can take out a city. Let them take out Los Angeles. Let them take out San Diego." Clips of the line pushed "San Diego," "LA or SD" and "25th Amendment" to the top of X's trends, and Gavin Newsom's response got 53K likes. The White House's rapid-response account said he meant the war was being fought to stop Iran from ever being able to hit those cities.
